questions.q: When should acceptance criteria for an AI drafting tool be set?
options: In the protocol, before the test run
After seeing the first results, so the bar matches what the model can realistically do
Only if the run fails
After go-live
questions.why: Criteria agreed in advance make the evidence objective.

questions.q: Two hard cases keep failing. A colleague suggests removing them from the test set. What is right?
options: Remove them, since rare cases distort the pass rate and are not part of normal use
Record the failures, fix the system and re-test
Replace them with easy cases
Lower the bar without telling QA
questions.why: Failures are recorded and resolved, never quietly removed.

questions.q: For a reportability draft, which criterion focuses on the misses that matter?
options: Average draft length
Number of words per answer
Every expert-marked reportable case is flagged for review
Average draft length within ten percent of the human-written records
questions.why: A missed reportable case is the costly error, so the criterion targets it.

questions.q: Besides the AI outputs, what else should validation test?
options: The colour of the screen
The model provider's office
Only the prompt wording, since the controls are covered by the QMS vendor's validation
Audit trail, signatures, roles and fallback to manual
questions.why: The controls around the AI are part of the validated system.

questions.q: After go-live, which signal suggests the validated state may be drifting?
options: A rise in how often reviewers reject drafts
A stable edit rate
Fewer meetings
A stable edit rate while complaint volume grows steadily each month
questions.why: Rising rejection or edit rates show inputs or behavior have changed.

questions.q: The team wants to ship a new prompt version. What does change control need?
options: Nothing if the change is small and the developer has tested a few examples by hand
A description, impact assessment, regression run against criteria and approval
Only a message to users
A new vendor contract
questions.why: Prompt and model changes go through change control with re-testing and approval.
